description: Uses one credit to create a bank-based income check and emails the applicant a secure link to connect their bank through Plaid. Confirm the applicant’s name and email with the user before calling. The report is ready after the applicant connects; check it with list_verifications or get_report.

purpose.description: Optional reason shown to the applicant, e.g. "Rental application for 12 Oak St"

requested_by_name.description: Name or company shown as the requester; defaults to the account’s company name

name: send_verification_request
title: Send an income verification request
